name: MEEZA QSTP-LLC (Public)
summary: MEEZA QSTP-LLC (Public) provides managed information technology (IT) services in Qatar. It offers data centre and managed, workplace, master system integrator, and cloud services. The company also provides software designing and programming; trades in computer network equipment and device; stores data and documents; and designs electronic sites. MEEZA QSTP LLC (Public) was founded in 2008 and is based in Doha, Qatar.
